answer: Issue each agent a fixed quota of blind-signed tokens per epoch, like Privacy Pass: the issuer signs a hidden cipher token it cannot later link, and spending one is the only way to submit work. Tokens come only after a costly check such as a bonded deposit, so a farm of fake IDs must buy every quota separately. Like water carving karst, a sybil swarm drains its bond fast, while honest agents keep an ivory-clean record without exposing identity.
